glosses: mashed potatoes (potatoes that have been boiled and mashed)
ein Brei aus zerstampften oder durchgepressten Salzkartoffeln, der mit Milch oder Sahne, Butter und Gewürzen (Salz, Pfeffer, Muskat) verrührt wird

examples.text: Für ein wohlschmeckendes Kartoffelpüree sollte man großzügig Butter unter die zerstampften Kartoffeln geben.
„Ich trug eine Scheibe Braten und Kartoffelpüree an unseren Tisch, und Papa trug einen Erbseneintopf mit Speck und Würstchen an unseren Tisch.“

translations.source_sense_description: Brei aus zerstampften oder durchgepressten Salzkartoffeln

glosses: Alternative form of mashed potatoes (“a dish consisting of potatoes that have been boiled, mashed to a pulpy consistency, and mixed with such ingredients as butter or milk”).

examples.text: “I would like a little lamb and some mashed potatoes,” said the diner to the waiter. The waiter called back to the kitchen: “One lamb and one mashed potato.”
‘You get used to the non-stop chattering and teasing,’ said Sorcha, with four-year-old Finn beside her, eagerly eating mashed potato and his own mini portion of turkey.
I believe I want a steak, well done, steamed broccoli and a mashed potato. For my appetizer I want clam chowder.

glosses: A single potato prepared in this manner.

examples.text: But what God wants is mashed potatoes. Not many potatoes—one mashed potato. No potato can stand up and say, “Here I am! I’m a potato.” The word must be we.
I have a vivid early memory of eating a meal of boiled shredded cotton flannel mixed with one mashed potato, as a soup which served our family for our one daily meal.

Remember how I said we eat just a few bites of carrot but a whole potato? Well, a single carrot has a glycemic index of 131 and contains only 4 grams of carbs, so its glycemic load is (1.31 x 4), or about 5. One mashed potato has a glycemic index of 104 and 37 grams of carbohydrates, so its glycemic load is (1.04 x 37), or just over 38.

glosses: A dance or a dance move popular in Western culture the 1960s.

examples.text:
Well, let's dance, well let's dance.
We'll do the twist, the stomp, the mashed potato too
Any old dance that you want to do
But let's dance.

translations.source_sense_description: Brei aus zerstampften oder durchgepressten Salzkartoffeln

glosses: A dish consisting of potatoes that have been boiled, mashed to a pulpy consistency, and mixed with such ingredients as butter or milk.

examples.text: Mashed potatoes is (or are) my favorite starch dish.

glosses: Partially melted snow with a pulpy texture, making for slow skiing.

examples.text: During late-season skiing, I have encountered ice in the morning and mashed potatoes in the afternoon.
The Eastern ski tribe could confidently expect much ice underfoot while the Western contingent could expect much mashed potatoes around the ankles.
I climbed back through the bottomless mashed potatoes as quickly as I could, relieved to see that his ski was off, with his foot pointing in a normal direction— not the skis’.

glosses: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see mash, potato.
